exportSummaries.AUTHORED_CONTENT_IDENTITY_EVIDENCE_PREFI: Canonical authored-content identity — same complete recursive canonicalize as `apps/ui-admin/src/ScenarioReviewGatePanel.tsx` (bfc98fcb).
exportSummaries.ApiAppContext: Typed composition context for the API app (composition-root pattern).
exportSummaries.ApiApplication: Fluent API application builder — the composition root for apps/api.
exportSummaries.ApiFacultyReviewDecisionRecord: Local faculty review-decision record (promote/hold demo surface).
exportSummaries.ApiFacultyScoreDraftRecord: Durable faculty score-draft record (review-workflow FacultyScoreDraft + session keys).
exportSummaries.ApiFetchHeaders: API fetch request-like validation (moved from apps/api composition root).
exportSummaries.CONTROL_SCENARIO_ID: Untouched control draft — counterweight that the gate still refuses unreviewed cases.
exportSummaries.FACULTY_COMPILE_LOCKS_DIR: Gitignored per-scenario lock store (compile runner reads this same path).
exportSummaries.PROMOTED_SCENARIO_ID: Chosen draft — bank index 3, in the first-12 queue mapping, seeds present.
exportSummaries.authoredScenarioContentIdentity: Canonical hash of the complete scenario minus documented non-authored/transient keys.
exportSummaries.compileLocksPathFor: Absolute path of the compile-locks file for a scenario.
exportSummaries.createInProcessDispatcher: fetch-shaped adapter over Hono `app.request` — records paths for transport proof.
exportSummaries.createScenarioRuntimeDurableStoreFromApi: Adapts API persistence sink methods into ScenarioRuntime's optional durableStore plus assembled-exam exam-run artifact hooks (review packet and run aggregate).
exportSummaries.inspectScenarioPromotionPath: The main proof: drive one REAL bank draft through four real SubmitScenarioReview decisions and record every hop.
exportSummaries.inspectStageZeroStaysBlocking: COUNTERWEIGHT — the stage condition is load-bearing.
exportSummaries.measureBankBaseline: Baseline measurement used by the pre-fix artifact: all 14 shipped scenarios, read through the real API — the readiness route (the REAL `isActivationEligible` over the whole pool), the real station-run-queue, and the REAL learner resolver (each queue record carries `bodySource`).
exportSummaries.parseFactoryRunRollup: Parse a raw rollup document into per-case station rows, refusing anything else.
exportSummaries.readFacultyCompileLocksRecord: Read the current lock record for a scenario; a missing file yields an empty record.
exportSummaries.registerFacultyCompileLockRoutes: Faculty compile-lock persistence route (WCG persist hole).
exportSummaries.registerPlatformRoutes: Platform/observability routes: health, telemetry snapshot, provider health, protocol posture, and runtime provider readiness.
exportSummaries.registerWorldCompileRoutes: Faculty world-compile route (WCG faculty button -> API).
